Definition: to clutch; hence, to seize as a prisoner
BiblicalUsage: To catch or seize is the word for the Benjamites lying in wait to catch wives from the daughters of Shiloh as they come out to dance. It is a snatching, sudden and planned, and the text leaves the ugliness of it standing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this verse shows how far Israel had fallen when every man did what was right in his own eyes, and seizing a wife could be planned in the open.
